scope: Real event→TasteProfile→affinity and diversity code; fixed hard-eligible pool. No candidate-retrieval, photographic relevance, conversion or causal business evaluation.
control: Same declared preferences, candidate IDs, hard filters, exclusions and diversity; learned weights zero.
evaluation: Disjoint fixed heldout SKU labels; training events never target heldout. At 0/10 the real feed remains blocked; diagnostic ranks do not imply feed access.
